value: Recognized by the U.S. Small Business Administration as the top Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) credit union lender in the state of Iowa
quote: Dupaco Community Credit Union received the U.S. Small Business Administration's (SBA) Impact Award for being the top Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) credit union lender in the state of Iowa.
Dupaco lent out nearly $30 million to 654 small businesses through the PPP, with an average loan size of just $45,000.
